run.decision: INVALID_MEASUREMENT. The frozen paired bootstrap mechanically passed all five gates, but the audit assumed 252 sessions/year while the source candidate/control paths are daily mixed-calendar series with roughly 365 marks/year after BTC was added. Because Sharpe and CAGR resampling annualization are therefore inconsistent with the data frequency, no bootstrap incremental PASS is accepted. This does not change the strategy. A successor statistical audit may only replace the annualization convention with an observation-frequency-aware method after the source strategy measurement itself is repaired; block size, candidate weight and strategy logic may not be rescue-tuned.

methodology.follow_up_policy: No failed bootstrap gate may trigger a different block size, seed, BTC weight, or strategy rescue. A failure closes the incremental robustness claim for this exact candidate. A pass supports a stronger incremental-evidence statement but does not overwrite source-trial WEAK validation.
methodology.selection_metric: No strategy selection and no parameter search. Apply the project-existing V11 paired circular moving-block bootstrap standard unchanged to the immutable candidate/control return pair.
